definitions.explanation: A swimming stroke performed face-down with alternating arm strokes and a flutter kick. The fastest and most commonly used stroke, also called freestyle in competitive swimming.

examples.japanese: クロール⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{泳法|えいほう}→泳法：24592_eihou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The front crawl is the fastest swimming stroke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{水泳|すいえい}→水泳：01623_suiei⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧クロール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}った→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: I learned the front crawl first at swimming class.

examples.japanese: クロール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧25⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦{泳|およ}げる→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I can now swim 25 meters doing the front crawl.

notes:
TERMINOLOGY:
- クロール (crawl) - refers to the stroke technique
- ⟦{自由形|じゆうがた}→自由形：18120_jiyuugata⟧ (freestyle) - competitive event name where any stroke is allowed (but crawl is always used as it's fastest)

TECHNIQUE TERMS:
- ⟦{息継|いきつ}ぎ→息継ぎ：19245_ikitsugi⟧ (breathing technique)
- ⟦バタ{足|あし}→バタ足：29972_bataashi⟧ (flutter kick)
- ⟦ストローク→ストローク：29970_sutorooku⟧ (arm stroke)
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かき→かき：noentry⟧ (arm pull)

FOUR SWIMMING STROKES (4⟦{泳法|えいほう}→泳法：24592_eihou⟧):
- クロール/⟦{自由形|じゆうがた}→自由形：18120_jiyuugata⟧ (freestyle/front crawl)
- ⟦{平泳|ひらおよ}ぎ→平泳ぎ：06526_hiraoyogi⟧ (breaststroke)
- ⟦{背泳|せおよ}ぎ→背泳ぎ：06527_seoyogi⟧ (backstroke)
- ⟦バタフライ→バタフライ：06544_batafurai⟧ (butterfly)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- クロール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧ (to swim front crawl)
- クロール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧ (to swim using front crawl)
- クロール⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{息継|いきつ}ぎ→息継ぎ：19245_ikitsugi⟧ (breathing in crawl)
